prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: existing Ashborne fantasy world map, revised biome artwork.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and authoritative map composition. Image 2 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the game's approved 2D painted art; do not insert its lion, warrior or scenery into the map.
Make precisely TWO geographically localized biome changes to Image 1. Keep its existing 1536x1024 landscape composition, all continent and island shorelines, all country boundaries and country positions, oceans, typography, title, all geographic names, Ashborne marker, legend, compass, and footer unchanged. No new text. No annotation marks or red outlines.

CHANGE A — LOWER-RIGHT NAMARAI ARCHIPELAGO:
The large broken ring/horseshoe archipelago in the bottom-right quarter, containing the existing names Nameri, Sairu, Talun and Orissa, is to become a VOLCANIC ARCHIPELAGO. Treat the whole Namarai group, including its southern island chains, as a coherent volcanic island arc. Preserve each island's outline, water channels, the large central gulf, the placement of all four country names and their settlement icons. Replace most of the existing ordinary green hills with bold hand-painted dark basalt, charcoal/slate volcanic ridges, muted brown ash fields and a chain of clearly recognizable volcanic cones with visible crater bowls. Include several large volcanoes distributed across the ring (one in northern Nameri highlands, one near Sairu, one in Orissa, one around Talun), and a few smaller dormant cones on outer southern islands. A FEW restrained orange-red glowing craters and narrow short lava streams on land should clearly communicate active volcanism, while other volcanoes remain dormant; no giant eruptions or destruction of cities. Keep small patches of muted green vegetation on lower slopes and coasts. The region must read immediately as a volcanic archipelago even when the map is reduced. Preserve legibility of all names on calm local color areas. Keep nearby oceans deep blue and retain a fully open central gulf. Do not touch Krynd at the bottom, Sarqesh to the left, or Eldavar above.

CHANGE B — FAR UPPER-RIGHT NORTHERN ELDAVAR MOUNTAIN BELT:
Turn the mountain band along the top-right/northern coast of Eldavar into a clearly ICY GLACIAL MOUNTAIN REGION, not just ordinary grey peaks with thin snow caps. This is the region north of the Veygard and Caldris labels, roughly x=950..1495 and y=35..205 in the 1536x1024 target; follow the actual northern mountain belt and its foothills, not a rectangular patch. Extend broad white and pale ice-blue snowfields across the northern ranges, sculpt glaciers between peaks and along valleys, add cyan-blue ice faces and cold blue shadow planes. Keep the existing organic mountain forms and coastline; do not create new islands, increase the continent size or cover the Eldavar label. Preserve the large Eldavar title and Veygard/Caldris names in their current positions, crisp and readable. Transition into the existing temperate land immediately south of the northern range; do not freeze the rest of Eldavar or Ashborne. The band should visibly read as a harsh permanent alpine/glacial biome. Orvath in the upper-left and Krynd at the bottom remain unchanged.

STYLE LOCK: Maintain the existing game's hand-painted stylized 2D treatment of large readable light/midtone/shadow color masses, clear organic silhouettes, selective edges and minimal texture; match the approved-scene reference's shaped rock planes. No photorealism, engraved hatching, microtexture, glossy 3D or mechanical low-poly tessellation. Keep the existing restrained color hierarchy, quiet cold dark ocean and thin antique-bronze frame. Lava is a localized warm accent, no blanket glow or dense particles. Ice reads through broad shaped white/blue planes, not glitter or lens effects. Do not alter any unrequested region, typography or UI; preserve the content and spelling of all original labels exactly.
